report.summary: Payments failed starting at 14:03 UTC on 2026-10-02 due to a code regression introduced by the deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 (chg-9890) at 14:02 UTC. The deployment refactored payment-intent validation and bumped the json library, resulting in NullPointerExceptions when processing null payer_vpa values.

supporting.note: A deployment on payments-api occurred at 14:02 UTC, precisely one minute before the error onset.
payments-api error rate began rising steeply at 14:03 UTC.
payments-api began throwing NullPointerExceptions at 14:03:05 UTC in PaymentIntentValidator due to a null payer_vpa.
mobile-bff error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC due to upstream dependencies failing.
mobile-bff logged upstream 500 errors from payments-api starting at 14:03:01 UTC.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Simultaneous client payload change from mobile app

supporting.note: The error specifically mentions that payer_vpa is null.

contradicting.note: A payments-api deployment occurred at 14:02 UTC, making a code-side validation change far more probable than an uncoordinated client payload change across all users at the exact same minute.

facts.text: mobile-bff error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 6.29% at 14:09.
payments-api error rate increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 20.29% at 14:07.
payments-api CPU usage increased starting at 14:03 UTC, peaking at 48.63% at 14:19.
mobile-bff logged upstream 500 errors from payments-api starting at 14:03:01 UTC.
payments-api logged NullPointerExceptions due to payer_vpa being null starting at 14:03:05 UTC.
payments-api was deployed (chg-9890) at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 with refactored payment-intent validation and a bumped json library.

assumptions: The refactored validation logic in payments-api v2.14.0 fails to guard against null payer_vpa values.

timeline.event: payments-api v2.14.0 deployed with refactored payment-intent validation
mobile-bff logs upstream 500 errors from payments-api
mobile-bff and payments-api error rates begin rising
payments-api logs NullPointerException in PaymentIntentValidator due to null payer_vpa

recommended_actions.action: Roll back payments-api to version 2.13.4 to restore previous payment-intent validation logic.
recommended_actions.rationale: Deployment chg-9890 introduced a code regression causing NullPointerExceptions and spiking error rates immediately after release.

recommended_actions.action: Add null safety checks and comprehensive unit tests for payer_vpa handling in PaymentIntentValidator.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevent future regressions from null payload fields during validation refactoring.

recommended_actions.action: Implement strict pre-release validation tests and canary deployments for payments-api changes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Catch validation regressions and unhandled null pointer exceptions before full production rollout.
